title: claude ultrareview refuses to run in scripts or CI after upgrading to 2.1.309
symptoms: claude ultrareview exits without running when no terminal is attached
workspace trust prompt appears for ultrareview on a terminal
Script that worked on 2.1.308 now refuses to start the review
cause: From 2.1.309, claude ultrareview requires workspace trust. On a terminal it asks. Without a terminal it refuses. Earlier versions did not check trust.
fix: Pass --trust-workspace in scripts. The flag takes no value, so put any PR number or base branch before it. Alternatively set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1 in the environment.
